purpose: Create a portable native Autodesk ReCap RCP from two real adjacent FARO stations using the current Desktop implementation, then relocate the entire package and verify relative station links.
tool: Autodesk DeCap via scan2bim.formats.recap_decap.create_recap_project; SCAN RCP manifest reader
acceptance: Verified native DeCap RCP creation and relative Support links after moving the output directory. Not a ReCap GUI open/edit/save/reopen acceptance and not evidence that the stations are registered. Stage 10 remains TESTING; Stage 4 remains open.
limitations: Only two adjacent stations were exported; the full 810-station source project was not copied.
The moved RCP manifest was checked with SCAN reader; ReCap GUI was not used.
Both RCP nodes remain registered=false; no transform was estimated, applied, or saved.
This run validates the current Desktop checkout only; the package is local to this workstation.
